name: child-translator
description: Child-friendly Chinese-Swedish speech translator - Minimal V1 (adult-only prototype)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @kt/server" "npm run dev -w @kt/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kt/web && npm run build -w @kt/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
